injuries.comment: Wilson is undergoing surgery for a fractured right hand and will miss at least four to six weeks, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
The Bulls reported on Sunday (Nov. 22) that Powell is to be re-evaluated later this week due to a hamstring injury.
Furphy could make his season debut in the next few weeks, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.
Head coach Rick Carlise confirmed Sheppard will miss "months" after undergoing surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee, Tony East of Forbes.com.
Head coach Rick Carlisle said Wednesday that Haliburton (hamstring) will miss at least 10 more days, Alex Golden of SI.com.
McConnell is Out for Friday's (Nov. 27) game against the 76ers.
